reason: The text explicitly demonstrates opposition and tension rather than collaboration between leaders/people and Samson. Critically, when the Philistines threaten Judah, the men of Judah come to Samson at Lechi saying 'Do you not know that the Philistines rule over us?' They then inform him they have come to bind him and hand him over to the Philistines, explicitly stating this is to prevent further conflict. Rather than working together, the people and Samson work against each other. The Philistine leaders do coordinate (with Delilah and each other) but this is predatory collaboration against Samson, not an example of unified leadership and people working toward common good.
